how_to_read.spearman_rho: Rank agreement of meeting-level hawkishness vs the compared series (d_same, FedLock m/ma, d_90).
how_to_read.why_action_days_rho_can_exceed_all_sched: Holds have d_same==0 (no rate variation); action days have real rate moves that ranks can track.
how_to_read.why_hold_day_rho_vs_d_same_undefined: d_same is constant 0 on holds — Spearman not computed; use dissent net and d_2y instead.
how_to_read.gate4_gap: Mean text score holds minus cuts: holds look less dovish than cuts on text even when rate labels do not separate hawkish vs dovish holds.
how_to_read.inversion_zero_stratum_A: Averaged two-order winner matched gold on all easy pairs — Jev sees obvious hawk vs dove text. Does NOT prove hard-pair calibration or policy forecasting.
how_to_read.bt_se: Uncertainty from pairwise Bradley-Terry fit (local likelihood curvature), not meeting-sampling variability. Sparse graph → cautious hold-day CIs.
how_to_read.haiku_vs_jev: Winner agreement (inversion) is primary; USD and latency_ms are separate axes. Latency is per-call API time; wall is concurrent.
how_to_read.ste: Standard error: Spearman = bootstrap SD of 1000 meeting resamples; rates = binomial sqrt(p(1-p)/n); means/Brier = sd/sqrt(n).
